name: sqli-lookup
description: SQL injection through lookup column names. For a CSV file, or the data replicated from SharePoint and DHIS2 which is held the same way, the q_column and f_column of /lookup/choices and /lookup/mlchoices, and the key column of a pulldata lookup, were written into the SQL unchanged. A column name with SQL in it must be refused rather than widen the query; a real column still works. Guards the LookupManager csvColumnName fix (2026-10-31). mlchoices shares the choices code. Survey data (linked_s, chart_s) maps a name to the question's column in the survey definition; probing it needs a form that references the file, so it is not probed here.
